# biomes/hearths: index

*Generated by `tools/make_index.py`. Do not edit; rerun it after adding or splitting fragments.*

The Hearths, a shared kit of life read in place by host kits (src/: the hearth trees, read by biomes/oidong), and its pages while its host (biomes/riftrim) has no build: the Hearth hold at 525,1400, one cave of two storeys on both: the Cave of Crystals (stations/crystals, dist/hearths-crystals.html; PLAN.md section 18), the drained storey, a Naica on core/terrain's KKARST (hypogene), KCAVERN, KSPELEO (selenite beams and the bladed floor, instanced), KTHERM and KGROUND, lethal heat on core/hazard; and the hold's active storey (stations/hold, dist/hearths-hold.html; section 19), warm water over every floor, scalding at the feeders, gypsum chandeliers, the fumarole; the hold's chambers, shelves, fields, galleries and approaches on both storeys massed and empty as plain records (CAVE.HOLD; ?massing=1). Verified: build.py, verify.py --assert.

Docs: `KNOWN_ISSUES.md`, `PLAN.md`, `PORT.md`
